messages.text:
The team should now start evaluating all options, discuss, and make a one-page written proposal per layout option together with a 2-page summary, this can be a MD file still.

If there are showstoppers to not go forward - flag this and tell us.

I’ll have the team evaluate all six magnetic layouts, challenge each other’s conclusions, and produce a one-page proposal per option plus a two-page summary. I’ll distinguish genuine showstoppers from missing evidence and flag anything that needs your direction before further work.

The first assessment flags a serious space concern for the outer solenoid with an iron return. A simple flux-area calculation demands more return area than the current muon host provides at the trial field levels. This is a warning requiring a proper magnetic solution—not proof that the topology is impossible. The team also found a public dual-solenoid concept for the active-return option, so that option now has a technical precedent to assess.

The team recommends investigating the toroid and inner-solenoid-plus-iron options first for independent muon measurements, while retaining both simple solenoids as comparisons. Cross-review has sharpened the caveats: no topology has a demonstrated intrinsic showstopper, and the outer-return warnings depend on explicit assumptions. The confirmed conflict is that the outer coil cannot coexist with the unchanged muon-host boundary.

The six one-page proposals and the two-page summary are drafted. They identify the conditions that would rule out a particular layout, the missing studies, and the next decisive test for each option. I’m adding them to PR #6 and updating its executive summary to lead with the team’s recommendations and warnings.

The evaluation is now in [PR #6](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/6), with links to all six proposals and the summary. The main warnings are the outer-coil/muon-host conflict and the conditional space demands of the outer iron and active returns. Missing field or fit studies are labelled as gaps in evidence, rather than grounds for rejecting a topology.

Added to [PR #6](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/6):

- Six one-page layout proposals.
- A [two-page team summary]([redacted]
- Cross-review findings, resource calculations, sources and an updated executive summary.

**Recommendation:** prioritize toroids (MAG-05) and inner-solenoid-plus-iron (MAG-02) for standalone-muon research; retain the other options for comparison and feasibility screening.

**Showstoppers:** none demonstrated for an entire topology. However:

- The outer coil conflicts with the unchanged muon host.
- Outer iron and active returns have serious, assumption-dependent space warnings.
- Missing field, material and measurement models prevent a defensible performance ranking.

These are preliminary technical assessments. CI and documentation checks passed; the working tree is clean.
